system.description: Reusable removable physical shield. While equipped and functional, grants damage reduction 1 using the custom armor rule. Only the highest equipped armor DR applies; does not stack with body armor. Does not activate a Barrier Shield, break automatically after a hit, or grant free attacks.
system.notes: Suggested homebrew price: 100 Mobiums. No automatic Dodge bonus. Broken or disabled shields grant no DR.

system.description: Reusable physical shield. Grants DR 1 while equipped and functional; only the strongest equipped armor DR applies. Use the existing Spiked Shield Bash attack (Melee, damage 5, reach 1 square) for an Action to strike one adjacent target. Requires this shield to be usable; GM verifies the shield is equipped. No automatic contact damage, free retaliation or free attack when blocking.
system.source: Community homebrew — untested; uses existing Egg Pawn Spiked Shield Bash profile
system.notes: Homebrew price: 200 Mobiums. Do not equip alongside another physical shield. Does not stack DR with armor or grant an additional Dodge bonus. Import Spiked Shield Bash separately from Weapons & Prices; that attack adds no additional gear-slot cost.

system.source: Community homebrew — untested; Terminal Velocity armored background Pawn from Sonic Colors / Ultimate
system.description: Action; one target within 2 squares. Requires equipped, functioning spear. Uses normal Melee versus defense. Range 2 is a homebrew reach adaptation. No free charge, reaction strike, extra hit or automatic knockback.
system.notes: Homebrew estimated price: 200 Mobiums. Removable weapon; equip to attack. Same profile as the Terminal Velocity Pawn spear.
